From Highway 65, take the Galleria Blvd South exit. Take a left on Roseville Pkwy and make a right on Taylor. The park will be on the right at the next light. From I-80 East Simply take the Atlantic Street Exit and stay straight on Taylor Road until you make to to the light and make a left. From I-80 west, take the Eureka Road exit, then make a left on Taylor. / [i]Payment: [/i] Arcades use a reloadable card that stores points (game credits) and tickets. Points are worth 20¢, while spending over $20 earns you bonus points. You can also buy a time-play card that allows you to play most games unlimited for a certain amount of time (tickets will be forfeited and games with pink and teal colored card readers will refuse to play). Card values don't carry to other locations. arcades.info_text: The Westfield Galleria Mall (RVM) location is on the bottom floor of the mall next to the east parking garage. They offer 4 pool tables, 8 bowling lanes, and two party sized karaoke rooms. Facing the mall, the crane games and restaurant seating are in the center, while shooting games are on the right and music games as well as racing games are on the left. Redemption games are scattered all over the arcade. Restrooms and bowling are in the back right corner. / Arcade Pricing: Requires game cards that have a white stripe near the bottom to play (Intercard system). Red cards are $2 each, while club cards are $5 per year. Prices start at $1 for four credits, but you get extra credits when you spend more in one purchase and/or depending on your club card tier. / History: RVM had its grand opening on August 6th, 2022, with Round1 giving away custom t-shirts to the first 300 visitors.
